undoBurst.note: T7-W6 / CH-53. TWO SURFACES, TWO NUMBERS. minFps 52 is the real-Safari floor for the manual matrix — the r1/T5-W1 train read 56.6 / 54.39 / 54.78 with ~15 long frames (perf-rig-run-manifest.txt:53-55), median 54.78, floored ~5% under. ciMinPctOfCeiling is what the CI subset grades (GATE C): headless WebKit and chromium both hold their ceiling on this window, so transposing 52/98.4 would hand CI a floor ~47% below live — the slack W6 exists to remove. 0.90 = the measured minimum over clean windows (100.09% of ceiling, chromium 100.26-100.7 / webkit 100.09-100.12) less 10 points; derivation in evidence/w6/perf-floor-derivation.md. RESTAMP AT WGATE per W6's floor-timing clause.

tbt.engines: every engine whose PerformanceObserver ships the longtask entry type — chromium does, WebKit does not; the CI subset reports an unsupporting engine NOT MEASURED and refuses a green if no engine could measure it at all
tbt.note: T7-W6 born at 1200, RESTAMPED 2026-08-03 (T7-W3) to 1750 on the number's first field contact — run 30799424855 at head 6d612ec5, the first time this lane ever ran it. STILL PROVISIONAL. 1200 was a darwin-derived guess at a host it had never seen, and it guessed low: the ubuntu runner reads 1276 / 1333 ms on a CLEAN tree (two VMs, 6 windows 1256-1368, load 0.92-1.96, control long33 0), so the incumbent sat UNDER the green-tree reading and was a false-red machine rather than a floor. NOT A REGRESSION — darwin at this same head reads medians 256 / 309 / 373 ms on a calm box against W6's 218-343 basis, same 10-11 task census, longest task 197-256 vs W6's 210-274. THE ARITHMETIC: worst quiescent runner window 1368 x 1.10 (the larger observed spread — within-run 1368/1256 = 1.089, cross-VM medians 1333/1276 = 1.045) = 1505, x 1.15 for GATE D being the one gate here with no app-free control (the control-validity law protects A/B/C; a contended boot TBT is graded as a bundle fact, and ci.yml never retries an exit 1) = 1730, rounded DOWN to the file's grain = 1750. The 1.15 buys the first slice of a MEASURED 3.4x exposure, not a cover for it: darwin, same dist, same 4x rate, frame control clean and EXIT=0 throughout, moved 256 -> 871 ms as the 1-minute load went 10 -> 41. The cure is a control, not a bigger number. TRIPWIRE RETAINED: 1750 - 1333 = 417 ms of headroom, so one new synchronous boot task of >=117 ms unthrottled (4x - 50) trips it, against an app whose own largest boot task is ~149 ms unthrottled — W6's declared regression class (a new synchronous raster or decode on the boot path) is still caught. NOT TRANSPOSED, and the refusal is measured: GATE B divides by a ceiling, but the fps ceiling is a frame-scheduler cap (the runner reports p50 = p95 = worst = 16.7 ms, a clamped quantity that carries no CPU-throughput information), so borrowing it here would be numerology. probe.js now measures the real denominator — fixed integer work under the same throttle, min of 3, checksummed — and ci-subset prints tbt/anchor beside the verdict, DIAGNOSTIC and gating nothing. RESTAMP AT WGATE at n>=3 runner readings: if tbt/anchor holds across host classes, transpose GATE D onto it and retire this absolute; if it does not, the transposition is refuted by measurement and a runner-derived absolute is the honest instrument. Derivations in evidence/w6/perf-floor-derivation.md and evidence/w3/gate-d-restamp.txt.
